title: Continuous maps to an arbitrary space form an fpqc sheaf of sets
statement: Let $D$ be any topological space, with no separation assumption, and use compatible universes for spaces and schemes [def-weil-size-convention, def-pc-scheme]. On the category of schemes, the presheaf of sets $U\mapsto C(|U|,D)$, whose restriction along $f:V\to U$ is $s\mapsto s\circ|f|$, is a sheaf for the fpqc topology [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Here $|U|$ is the underlying Zariski topological space and $C(|U|,D)$ denotes continuous functions to the given topology on $D$.
